subject.title: Telegram: specific forum topic becomes permanent inbound black hole after stuck-session recovery

question: Should this remain a separate canonical investigation for persistent post-restart Telegram forum-topic black holes, or can it be folded into the guarded-lane recovery work only after same-root proof?
rationale: The source proves an overlapping guarded-lane failure, but the issue and corroborating comment add durable single-topic suppression after restarts and session deletion, which is broader than the open in-process lane PR.

options.title: Keep Separate Persistent Topic Investigation
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical durable-state investigation and require live or restart-replay proof before closure.

options.title: Fold After Same-Root Proof
options.body: Fold this into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91456 only if maintainers confirm the same guarded-lane root cause explains the post-restart forum-topic behavior.

options.title: Close After Future Fix Proof
options.body: Close later only when a merged fix proves fresh non-reply forum-topic inbound messages recover after stuck-session recovery and restart.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Persistent Topic Investigation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical durable-state investigation and require live or restart-replay proof before closure.

likelyOwner.reason: His prior Telegram isolated-ingress recovery work is the strongest owner trail for the lane, reply-fence, and restart semantics at issue.
